clientSdk.name: VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer
clientSdk.usedFor: Establishing and holding the authenticated VCF session (Connect-VcfInstallerServer) whose ServiceUri and SessionSecret drive the SDDC LCM requests.
clientSdk.note: The published VMware.Sdk.Vcf PowerCLI modules do not generate cmdlets for the SDDC LCM service, so the getComponents and getComponentNodes operations named above are issued directly against the pinned contract. The modules are installed by the environment and are never vendored into this repository.
